# claude

Claude Code, with a custom theme rendered from the palette.

The theme is copied (not linked) to `~/.claude/themes/mango.json`: Claude Code hot-reloads a changed file there, which it would not see behind a symlink. `setup.sh` selects `custom:mango` only if no theme was ever chosen; `/theme` in Claude Code goes back.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`claude/packages`): `claude-code` (AUR)

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `claude/theme.json.tmpl` → `claude/theme.json`: `accent`, `ansi13`, `bg_desktop`, `bg_hover`, `bg_surface`, `bg_widget`, `border_inactive`, `error`, `fg_disabled`, `fg_muted`, `fg_secondary`, `fg_text`, `link`, `name`, `selection_bg`, `success`, `term_bg`, `variant`, `warning`

**`setup.sh`** (run by `install.sh --setup`): install the palette theme and select it, only where no theme was ever chosen ("theme" unset; "auto" is a real choice in Claude Code's /theme menu). Idempotent.

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): copy the palette's Claude Code theme into ~/.claude/themes. Running sessions hot-reload it. Skipped when Claude Code isn't installed or configured.
